summary: A search for a campaign's audience ended — finished, exhausted, stalled or stopped — with what it was asked for, found and landed; said once per search, a default manager trigger.

key.description: The search's work item: one line per search.

audience.description: The audience the search ran under.

plugin.description: The plugin the search ran at.

ended_as.description: How it ended: it reached its count, the source ran out, its reads landed nobody for the stall bound, or a stop ended it.

state.description: The provider's last word for the search, or null where no read answered: after a stall, why it stood still.

asked.description: How many people the search was asked for.

found.description: How many the provider said it found, or null where it never said.

landed.description: How many members of the campaign the search made.

ended_by.description: The work item whose answer ended it — the last read, the stop, or the search itself — or null for a stall, which the dispatcher decides.
